dimensions.note: 국립생물자원관's 어린이 생물도감 (BRIS child illustrated-encyclopedia entries, e.g. the 가는갯능쟁이 species entry) reads as an unmodified taxonomic-description register: classification-family-name, distribution, then morphology, with 한자어 terms left unglossed. This independently corroborates ref:kma-kids-weather-classroom's finding from a different institution (National Institute of Biological Resources, a species-data agency, vs. Korea Meteorological Administration) and a different domain (botany vs. meteorology): a resource explicitly labelled for children can carry an entirely unmodified specialist register with no concrete-scene lead-in, no gloss, and no restatement. This record was assigned holdout before reading and does not originate this finding; it validates the trait already found at ref:kma-kids-weather-classroom.
dimensions.evidence: 가는갯능쟁이 (Atriplex gmelinii) entry: "명아주과 1년생 초본으로 우리나라 중부 이남 해변에 분포한다." — opens with family classification (명아주과) and lifecycle term (1년생 초본) before any concrete image of the plant, and 명아주과/1년생 초본 are not glossed anywhere in the passage read.

dimensions.note: Only a single short species entry was read (one to two sentences); the finding above is limited to that entry's register and should not be read as a survey of every entry in this encyclopedia, some of which may vary in adaptation quality. Sentence length, clause depth, and hedging under uncertainty were not assessable from the fragment available.

weaknesses: Same institutional-register-under-a-child-label anti-pattern as ref:kma-kids-weather-classroom: a resource titled '어린이' opens a species description with unglossed taxonomic classification rather than a concrete, familiar image of the organism, which is the opposite of the concrete-before-abstract sequencing the audience profile requires.
Evidence base is thin (one entry, one sentence); this record cannot support claims beyond the single anti-pattern instance it validates.
notes: corpus_role: holdout, assigned before any reading of this reference began, per docs/architecture/LANGUAGE-QUALITY-ARCHITECTURE.md §7 — this record validates the 'labelled child, register unadapted' finding originated at ref:kma-kids-weather-classroom and must never be treated as having originated it itself. This is evidence about the child-upper-elementary AUDIENCE, not a genre or a biology-content-type finding: the mismatch (a taxonomy register under a child label) is a general risk for any institutional reference material addressed to children, not specific to species encyclopedias. 'beginner-learner' is deliberately omitted from applicable_to.audiences for the same reason as the paired discovery record: this register would be unremarkable, not a failure, for an adult general reader — the failure is age-specific. Requires the applicability.audiences enum in schemas/reference-evaluation.schema.json to admit 'child-upper-elementary' (flagged already on the SUE-604 discovery/holdout pair in this corpus; not yet present as of this writing). No encyclopedia content was reproduced beyond the single quoted sentence, consistent with editorial/RIGHTS-AND-PROVENANCE.md's fail-to-reference rule.
